latestVersion.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edits baby dance videos via a cloud AI pipeline; just upload clips and describe your edit.
- Supports popular formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB) and exports polished 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic authentication with free credits and session management—no manual setup required.
- Handles uploads, editing commands, preview, export, and credit checks with clear error handling.
- Designed for parents and creators to quickly create share-ready baby dance compilations, no manual editing needed.
